questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: The history of social media
Why baby boomers are rich
The young generation that grew up with social media
How companies advertise their products to millennials online
questions.why: They focus on Generation Z, 'the social media generation'.

questions.q: Which generation do Neil and Rob belong to?
options: Generation X
Baby boomers
Millennials
Generation Z
questions.why: Rob confesses he is Generation X, and Neil says 'Yes me too'.

questions.q: What mainly makes Generation Z different?
options: They were born in the 1980s
They don't use technology much
They have more money to spend than any other generation
They have never known life without social media
questions.why: Neil says they have never known a time without social media.

questions.q: How does Rob react when he hears that Gen Z have always had social media?
options: He is jealous of them
He feels sorry for them
He doesn't believe it
He thinks it makes them clever

questions.q: According to analyst Hiral Patel, how do most people see Generation Z?
options: As a completely new type of consumer
As lazy and uninterested
As similar to baby boomers
As mini-millennials
questions.why: She says 'Most people view Generation Z as mini-millennials'.

questions.q: What does Hiral Patel's research show?
options: Gen Z have their own values and preferences
Gen Z and millennials are the same
Gen Z don't buy anything online
Gen Z trust brands more than older people
questions.why: She says their research shows Gen Z are different, with their own values and preferences.

questions.q: Why is this research important for companies?
options: They need to hire more young workers who understand technology
They must provide what Gen Z want to sell to them
They should stop using social media
They should only sell to millennials
questions.why: Neil says companies that want to sell to this generation need to cater for it.

questions.q: How does Neil compare himself with Gen Z?
options: He knows much more about modern technology than young people do
He never uses modern technology
He's comfortable with it, but for Gen Z it's always been normal
He thinks they use too much technology
questions.why: Neil says he's savvy but didn't grow up with it, while for Gen Z it's their norm.
